meta.title: SenseNova Model Access
meta.description: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
